author: Boniki
quote: I never imagined that the "woke" agenda would destroy the world of gaming, just as it did with cinema. It’s truly regrettable. In their marketing, they promised realism—using misleading imagery to drive pre-sales—but instead delivered a broken game, riddled with bugs and technical issues, featuring "woke" dialogue. They even shipped an empty case with no disc; in short, it’s an embarrassment to the gaming industry. Greed has destroyed customer loyalty. I’d also like to know how much was paid to secure that 9.9 rating. Everyone knows those scores are a sham.

author: Boniki
quote:
Perfeito em todos os sentidos. Este jogo representa o verdadeiro sentido e prazer de se jogar um video game no ano de 2026. 
Parabéns aos artistas envolvidos nesta produção maravilhosa.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
